route_parameter_style: React Router colon parameters; OpenAPI operation paths use braces
common_invariants: Every route resolves to exactly one screen_id and every screen_id is present exactly once.
UI role visibility and API authorization use the same policy decision; hidden navigation never substitutes for server authorization.
ACTIVE_TENANT guards require token active_tenant_id, current membership, route resource tenant equality, and transaction-local RLS context.
PUBLIC_REGISTRY_READ permits only allowlisted immutable public registry data; no tenant-scoped row is addressable without current rights.
MFA_REAUTH guards require a verified MFA session and reauthentication age at most 15 minutes.
allowed_dynamic_segment: Named route parameters shown with a leading colon only; implementations percent-decode once, reject slash/backslash/dot-segment ambiguity, and validate typed IDs before lookup.

operation_resolution_contract.inheritance_rule: Every api_operations entry inherits the same screen row requirement_ids as its capability/intent and e2e_test_ids as its executable evidence path. requirement_ids MUST equal the reverse screen_ids edges in requirements-test-registry.json, and at least one screen test MUST link back to one inherited requirement.
operation_resolution_contract.row_closure_rule: Each operation_id occurs once and its requirement_ids, test_ids, and evidence_ids exactly equal the enclosing screen capability and executable evidence edges; every linked test shares at least one linked requirement.

operation_semantic_contract.operation_projection: screen_id plus each ordered operation_contract with semantic_case_sha256 omitted
operation_semantic_contract.aggregate_projection: Screen order then operation order, exactly 113 rows
